title: Cannot download data from night scout after reinstallation
symptom: After reinstalling xDrip on a Samsung S9 with Android 10, the user cannot download past BG and treatment data from Nightscout even though Download Data is enabled under Cloud Upload > Nightscout Sync. History only shows BG from a day, and the user hopes to restore three months of past BG data.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; a maintainer states that downloading BG readings from Nightscout is not possible.
fix: No fix is provided; the maintainer suggests asking in the Nightscout group for options and closes the issue.
evidence_quote: You cannot download the BG readings from Nightscout. Please ask in the Nightscout group for options.
